scenarios.name: tapland-entering-untaps-itself
scenarios.why: Boros Guildgate enters tapped, so Tiller Engine's 'whenever a land you control enters tapped' trigger fires; choosing the first mode untaps that land, leaving it untapped.

scenarios.name: tapland-entering-taps-an-opposing-nonland
scenarios.why: The second mode taps a target nonland permanent an opponent controls, so p1's Grizzly Bears becomes tapped while the Guildgate stays tapped.

scenarios.name: land-entering-untapped-does-not-trigger
scenarios.why: A Forest enters untapped, so the 'enters tapped' condition is false and Tiller Engine's trigger never fires; the Forest stays untapped and no mode is posed.
